definitions.gloss: funds allocated on top of a previously approved budget; a supplementary or additional budget
definitions.explanation: Money added to an existing budget after the original plan has been set. Used in both government finance (supplementary national budgets) and private-sector contexts (project cost overruns, new requirements requiring extra spending).

examples.japanese: {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}を{申請|しんせい}する。
プロジェクトに{追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}が{必要|ひつよう}になった。
examples.english: An additional budget became necessary for the project.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{災害|さいがい}{復興|ふっこう}のために{追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}を{組|く}むと{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced that it would put together an additional budget for disaster recovery.

examples.japanese: {資材|しざい}{価格|かかく}の{高騰|こうとう}により、{当初|とうしょ}の{見積|みつも}りを{超|こ}える{追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}の{承認|しょうにん}が{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: Due to rising material costs, approval is being sought for an additional budget exceeding the original estimate.

notes:
Composed of {追加|ついか} (addition; adding on) + {予算|よさん} (budget). A straightforward compound used in both public and private finance contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}を{組|く}む: to put together an additional budget
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}を{申請|しんせい}する: to apply for additional budget
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}を{計上|けいじょう}する: to enter an additional budget into the books
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}を{承認|しょうにん}する: to approve an additional budget
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ: additional budget is required
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}の{要求|ようきゅう}: a request for additional budget

RELATED GOVERNMENT-FINANCE TERMS:
- {補正|ほせい}{予算|よさん}: supplementary budget — the technical Japanese-government term for a formal revision of the national budget after it has passed the Diet.
- {当初|とうしょ}{予算|よさん}: original / initial budget
- {本|ほん}{予算|よさん}: the main budget
- {暫定|ざんてい}{予算|よさん}: provisional budget
- {予備|よび}{費|ひ}: reserve funds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}: general term for any extra budget added to a plan.
- {補正|ほせい}{予算|よさん}: the specific legal term for a supplementary national budget in Japan; always refers to the government.
- {増額|ぞうがく}: an increase in amount — focuses on the change, not the resulting budget.
- {予算|よさん}{超過|ちょうか}: over budget — describes the state of having exceeded the budget, not the extra allocation itself.

USAGE:
- Project management: when cost estimates rise or new requirements emerge
- Government finance: disaster response, economic stimulus, unforeseen expenses
- Academic research: grants requiring extra funds mid-project
- Construction: cost overruns due to material or labor prices
